name: usage-meter
description: Shows your 5-hour and weekly usage limits and context size as colored gradient bars at the bottom, beside the mode line under the prompt

shape.title: Bar shape
shape.description: How bars are drawn; pill and powerline need a Nerd Font

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: gradient: each cell colored by its place along the bar; solid: the whole fill in the color for its level

resetTime.title: Reset time
resetTime.description: Time until a limit resets: countdown (2h0m), clock (14:00), or off

label5h.title: 5-hour label
label5h.description: Text before the 5-hour bar; empty hides it

label7d.title: 7-day label
label7d.description: Text before the weekly bars; empty hides it

labelContext.title: Context label
labelContext.description: Text before the context bar; empty hides it

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: Between meters, with a space each side; empty leaves two spaces

usageYellowAt.title: Usage yellow at (%)
usageYellowAt.description: Where the 5h and 7d bars reach yellow

usageOrangeAt.title: Usage orange at (%)
usageOrangeAt.description: Where the 5h and 7d bars reach orange

usageRedAt.title: Usage red at (%)
usageRedAt.description: Where the 5h and 7d bars reach red

ctxYellowK.title: Context yellow at (k tokens)
ctxYellowK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, where the context bar reaches yellow

ctxOrangeK.title: Context orange at (k tokens)
ctxOrangeK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, where the context bar reaches orange

ctxRedK.title: Context red at (k tokens)
ctxRedK.description: Context size, in thousands of tokens, where the context bar is red and full

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: Cells per bar; 0 sizes them to the terminal

colorGreen.title: Color: green
colorGreen.description: Hex like #a7c080 to replace the theme's low color; empty keeps the theme's

colorYellow.title: Color: yellow
colorYellow.description: Hex to replace the theme's yellow; empty keeps the theme's

colorOrange.title: Color: orange
colorOrange.description: Hex to replace the theme's orange; empty keeps the theme's

colorRed.title: Color: red
colorRed.description: Hex to replace the theme's red; empty keeps the theme's

colorTrack.title: Color: track
colorTrack.description: Hex for the empty part of the bars; empty keeps the theme's
